The change meets the task and the stated definition of done. I checked the one place I was unsure about: `invoiceView` in `internal/api/invoices.go` embeds `store.Invoice`, so the `number` field appears in every invoice answer. - **Numbering:** `CreateInvoice` assigns the number after validation, so failed creates take none. `UpdateInvoice` keeps the stored number. Loading v1/v2 numbers unnumbered invoices by (created_at, ID) per organization, and continues after the highest existing number.
